comparison.objective: Slide one curling stone toward a target while intercepting a collision-driven runaway stone; candidate finishes inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed bimanual sliding and dynamic interception versus localized coaxial tool alignment, impact delivery, and tiny-object recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Authorized shot completed with runaway rescued and all four stones retained on the board; detailed target thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four fractures with no tang loss or damage.
comparison.reason: Both involve impacts in a broad sense, but the curling task tests planar collision management, not tool-driven material separation.
